title: A complete human genome sequence was published in 2022
summary: Nurk and colleagues' Science paper is titled as the complete sequence of a human genome.
body: Sergey Nurk and colleagues, "The complete sequence of a human genome" (Science, 2022), report a gapless assembly. The v1 article stops at 2003. For retrieval, "the human genome was finished in 2003" and "a complete sequence was published in 2022" answer different questions. Both can be true if 2003 means the project's declared product and 2022 means a sequence without the remaining gaps.
